name: corsen-context-monorepo
description: Universal AI Context Layer — MCP Adapter + Enhanced llms.txt + Smart Sitemap
author: Corsen AI <contact@corsen.ai>

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context build && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-nextjs build && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-cli build
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context lint && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-nextjs lint && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-cli lint
scripts.clean: corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context clean && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-nextjs clean && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-cli clean
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context build && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-nextjs typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @corsenai/corsen-context-cli typecheck
